message: Not recommended to improve glycaemic control when eGFR < 45 mL/min/1.73 m2. KDIGO 2022 Rec 1.3.1 supports SGLT2i at eGFR >= 20 for kidney/heart protection - a different purpose; flag for the clinician.
source: FARXIGA (dapagliflozin) US prescribing information (DailyMed); KDIGO 2022 Diabetes in CKD

message: Not recommended for glycaemic control in type 1 diabetes.
History of ketoacidosis: SGLT2 inhibitors carry a ketoacidosis warning; clinician review.
Renal dose adjustment required per label when eGFR < 45 mL/min/1.73 m2. This system never displays doses - consult the label.
Not studied in patients with a history of pancreatitis; acute pancreatitis reported after marketing.
Heart failure observed with two other DPP-4 inhibitors (class-level); consider risks and benefits.
Sulfonylureas can cause severe hypoglycaemia; prior hypoglycaemia increases concern.
Older patients are at higher hypoglycaemia risk; label advises a conservative start. Age cut-off 65 is team-set.
